title.narrative: Activity under preparation EU-Vietnam Support Measures

description.narrative: The EU-Vietnam Support Measures implement the support measures under the second part of the Multiannual Indicative Programme 2021-2027 with Vietnam as adopted in the Mid-Term Review for 2025-27. It covers the cooperation facility, in line with ARES note Ares(2024)3816171 on the transfer of responsibilities for the programming and implementation of the Support Measures appropriations to EU Delegations in Asia and the Pacific.The Overall Objective of this action is to advance the EU-Vietnam partnership. The Specific Objectives of this action are to:1. Provide further support for the implementation of the priorities of EU cooperation with Vietnam, Team Europe Initiatives and Global Gateway implementation, including its 360° approach, and the development of the next MFF;2. Support strategic communication of the EU in Vietnam, relating to raising awareness, understanding and perception of the European Union¿s partnership with the country, particularly around Global Gateway flagship projects and Team Europe Initiatives. The action will be implemented in direct management (procurement) via a limited number of service contracts, each concluded with a respective specialised service provider. Environmental protection and climate change, gender equality and empowerment of women and girls, human rights, disability, reduction of inequalities, democracy, and disaster risk reduction will be mainstreamed in all aspects of the action.This action contributes in particular to SDG 17 (Partnership for the Goals). Other SDGs targeted are more specifically the SDGs 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 12, 13, 15 and 16. The action also contributes to the EU Roadmap for Engagement with Civil Society, the EU Roadmap for Engagement with Youth, the EU Human Rights and Democracy Strategy, the EU Strategy on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and the EU Gender Action Plan III, in particular its thematic area of engagement on ¿Promoting equal participation and leadership¿.
